besluite.fout: 'oor en oor' copies English 'over and over'
besluite.rede: 'Keer op keer' is the natural Afrikaans idiom, has the same meaning and the same word count, and touches no protected word.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
besluite.rede: 'Party plase hou ... aan' and 'ander plant ... gewasse' each have their own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma; no words are added.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
besluite.rede: 'Daar woon min mense' and 'daar is min winkels en dienste' are two full clauses joined by 'en', so the comma is required.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
besluite.rede: 'n Dorp is groter' and 'die huise staan nader' each have their own subject and verb, so the comma is required and the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
besluite.rede: The second 'en' starts a new clause ('die verkeer is dikwels stadig') rather than a list item, the list itself keeps no comma before its 'en', and 'minibus-taxi's' stays intact.
